author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy map designer and character illustrator wanted
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely does not have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you are a fantasy author recommending someone you have personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. For character art, prefers realistic, epic fantasy concept art over cartoon illustration; book is lighter fantasy but art should feel grounded and lifelike; open to different styles; bonus if you can do POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Portraits for the time being, with more work if the style fits the series. For the map, wants something detailed and immersive with a classic fantasy-map feel, stylistically open. Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites.

author: Tee Yuan Xin
title: Freelance graphic designer for client visuals
content: Looking for a Freelance Graphic Designer. Currently looking for someone who can support us on upcoming client projects, mainly for social media visuals, ads creatives, campaign posters, and simple visual adaptations / resizing. Prefer someone with a good eye for clean and modern design, who can follow brand guidelines / references, is responsive and able to meet deadlines, and is comfortable handling ad and social media creatives. Follow-up: freelance / project-based, with potential for more ongoing projects. If interested, drop your portfolio + rate in the comments or DM @yuanxin_289.
